2. The present petition has been preferred for the following reliefs:-
Usha Devi vs The Union Of India on 7 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197767939/
1 (i) for issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus commanding the Respondents Patna High Court CWJC No.17637 of 2022(6) dt.07-05-2024 authorities concerned restraining them to acquire the land including the part of the building up to 5th floor of the petitioner situated in kheshra no. 2020 of khata no. 460 of Mouza - Dighi Kala in Hajipur Town just by the eastern side of N.H. 77 on the basis of the illegal yellow mark done by the respondents authorities concerned on 9.11.2022 all of a sudden about 4 feet 3 inch from the southern side of the building from west towards east and about 11 feet yellow mark in the Northern side from west towards east on the building of the petitioner without any prior notice given to the petitioner, without any gazette notification for acquisition of the said land in question of the petitioner in the third phase and even without any rhyme and reason given to the petitioner for the yellow mark done by the respondents concerned on the wall of the petitioner as it would be evident from the photographs of the building of the petitioner contained in Annexure-6 series of this writ application itself;
(ii) for issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus commanding the respondents concerned by restraining them to demolish the parts of the building of the petitioner till the final decision of this case, situated over the aforesaid land in question up to the illegal yellow marks done by the respondents concerned on 9.11.2022 all of a sudden on the internal walls of the building of the petitioner, since they have given threatening Patna High Court CWJC No.17637 of 2022(6) dt.07-05-2024 to the petitioner to demolish the same very soon without any rhyme and reason given to the petitioner, without any prior notice of the same given to the petitioner and without any basis for acquisition of the land in question of the petitioner;
(iii) for issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus commanding the respondents concerned to make payment of the due compensation to the petitioner as per the commercial rate along with the interest thereon since 2013 till date as per the Bank rate with respect to an area of 1.2 decimal of the aforesaid land in question earlier in the second phase of the acquisition done by the respondents concerned in pursuant to the Gazette Notification contained in Annexure 4 and 5 of the Writ Application as the same have not been paid to the petitioner till date nor any notice U/S 3-G(3) of the N.H. Act has been sent to the petitioner till date for preparation of the award with respect to the same and the due compensation of the petitioner has been illegally withheld by the respondents concerned although the Respondents concerned had taken possession over the same in 2013 itself by demolishing the part of the building of the petitioner under the acquisition in second phase and the four lane of N.H. 77 along with Railway Flyover Bridge on Railway Gumti No. 54 of Hajipur-Barauni Railway line has already been completed in 2019 itself and the same have already been opened for the general Patna High Court CWJC No.17637 of 2022(6)
dt.07-05-2024 public in 2019 itself.
3.

4. A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent- the District Land Acquisition Officer, Vaishali and paragraph-6 read as follows:-
"6. That before giving para wise comment to the writ application the answering respondents would like to submit as follows:-
I. That the land situated in mauza Dighi Kala, Hajipur, Thana No. 105, the land of the petitioner bearing Khata no. 460 plot no. 2020 had been acquired for the project NH-77 (Hajipur to Muzaffarpur) four lane construction in two phase of road construction.

sentences.text: Requisition was filed for land acquisition in the plot No. 2020 by requisitioning authority, NHAI, Chhapra.
After receiving the requisition, land acquisition process was initiated and started according to NH Act 1956.
II. That it is to submitted that in the first phase of land acquisition, Land acquisition process has been done as per section 3A of NH Act 1956.

The notification of 3A for acquisition of land of Patna High Court CWJC No.17637 of 2022(6) dt.07-05-2024 Mauza Dighi Kala had been done bide S.O> NO. 2662 dated 21.10.2009 and 3D of the aforesaid village has been notified vide S.O. No. 409 (E) dated 16.02.2010 in which 0.024 hectare land of khata no. 460 khesra no. 2020 was acquired.

Further another additional requisition in second phase for that land, acquisition proposal received and 3A notification was published vide S.O. No. 1161 (E) dated 23.05.2012 and 3D notification was published vide S.O. No. 1327 (E) dated 22.05.2013 in which 0.010 hectare of khata no. 460 khesra no. 2020 was acquired.
According to notification, award of that acquired land khata no. 460, khesra no. 2020 area 0.024 hectare and 0.010 hectare had been prepared, separately.
Notices had been sent to concerned raiyats to receive their compensation amount.
Many raiyats have received compensation amount of her acquired land in first phase.

The petitioner received compensation amount of Rs. 506028.00 (80%) and 14029.00 (20%) of compensation amount for the share of her land bearing khesra no. 2020 area 0.0112 Hec land as well as for the structure/ building, built upon that land, is Rs.
2834366.00 rupees also received by the petitioner.
III. That in second phase, land acquisition process of area 0.010 hectare of the land bearing khesra no. 2020 had been done.
Award amount of Rs. 2034909.00 for that area had been prepared and notice was issued to concerned Patna High Court CWJC No.17637 of 2022(6) dt.07-05-2024 Raiyats on the basis of MVR rate.
Till date petitioner did not submitted relevant papers to receive her compensation amount.
NHAI authority demarcated the acquired land.
But the petitioner built again a pacca house on that acquired land and encroached the acquired land.
She did not claim for the compensation amount for the part of second phase acquired land.

She would have to claim for that acquired land with relevant papers before the competent authority but she failed to do so, another raiyaats of this acquired land had received the Usha Devi vs The Union Of India on 7 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197767939/
3 compensation amount of their respective share in the second phase of land acquired.
NH Authorities had demarcated the acquired land and started construction of road work.

sentences.text: Petitioner has objection about second phase of land acquisition notification.
She has denied to give position on the land which was demarcated after second phase acquisition.
After receiving first award amount she built a pacca house on the additional acquired land without consent of NHAI while NHAI clearly demarcated the acquired land khesra no. 2020.
The steps and action of the petitioner is against the Land Acquisition Act."
5. The petitioner has filed reply to the counter affidavit wherein she has accepted to have received the compensation amount for the first phase of acquisition.

6. So far as the second phase of acquisition is Patna High Court CWJC No.17637 of 2022(6)
dt.07-05-2024 concerned, it is her contention that no notice was ever issued to her and as such, she failed to appear.
7. However, so far as the contention of the State that the yellow mark has been put in on the structure for which payment has already been made, no clear cut denial is there.
8. Learned Counsel for the petitioner wanted incorporation of specific paragraph of the reply to the counter affidavit.

However, despite giving sufficient time to him to provide the details where he has made categorical denial having not constructed the structure on the land acquired, learned Counsel for the petitioner failed to specifically point out the details.

9. In that background, this Court is satisfied that so far as the first prayer of the petitioner is concerned regarding putting in of yellow mark on her structure, the same is related to the first phase of acquisition for which compensation has already been received by her.

10. So far as the second phase of compensation is concerned, contrary to the stand of the petitioner that no notice has been given to her, it is the categorical statement of the State in the counter affidavit duly received by learned Counsel for the petitioner that pursuant to the notification issued,
though Patna High Court CWJC No.17637 of 2022(6) dt.07-05-2024 adjoining raiyats came forward and took compensation, the petitioner failed to appear along with all the relevant documents and as such, the compensation for the second phase of acquisition could not be made to her.

11. In that background when the petitioner herself has chosen not to approach the District Land Acquisition Officer, Vaishali, pursuant to the directions/notices issued by the respondent, no relief can be granted to her.

12. The writ petition has got no merit and is dismissed.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Neha/-
